1.finding: A Semgrep timeout never fails make ci-local: scripts/ci/local.sh:118 takes Semgrep's exit code ('rc=$?'), and `--error` fails on findings, not on errors; the inline evaluation (:119-127) prints 'error: <type> <path>' without the rule
1.interface: `python3 -I tools/check_semgrep_report.py --semgrep-exit <code> <report.json>` (stdlib only). Exit 0 on a pass; non-zero on a finding, an error in scope, a missing, empty or unreadable report (also valid JSON that is not an object with the lists 'results' and 'errors') or a non-zero --semgrep-exit; a missing, empty or non-integer --semgrep-exit fails too, and its message names the option (A2). Output: per finding a line with rule, path and line ('<check_id>  <path>:<line>' as today, scripts/ci/local.sh:123); per error one line holding its type (for a list type such as ["PartialParsing", [<spans>]] only its first element), its path (if any) and its rule_id (if any); never an extra.fix, extra.lines or spans, and never the message of an error with a path (AC5); an error without a path additionally prints the first line of its message, cut to about 200 characters (AC5 as amended at gate 1, owner 2026-11-18: „Meldung ja“; the cases do not decide this, they forbid the message only for the parse error and the timeout, both with a path); the summary line exactly '<n> files, <f> finding(s), <i> error(s) in scope (<t> timeout(s)), <o> error(s) out of scope (<u> timeout(s))' with n = len(paths.scanned); a bad report is named by the path given. Scope: one list of exempt globs in the tool's header, today only 'evals/golden/*/korrektur.html', where '*' is one path segment (evals/golden/a/sub/korrektur.html is in scope), anchored at both ends (apps/web/evals/golden/a/korrektur.html is in scope) and case-sensitive; an error without a path is always in scope. The exemption applies to errors only: a finding on an exempt page is printed, counted and fails (A1). Errors out of scope are printed as well (W2, ticket: 'prints findings and errors as scripts/ci/local.sh:122-125 does today').
1.localSh: scripts/ci/local.sh (semgrep_scan, :113-129): the inline Python is replaced by the tool, run as today in $PYTHON_IMAGE with --network none, the export mounted read-only (the tool is part of the export at /src/tools/check_semgrep_report.py, or mount it); pass Semgrep's rc as --semgrep-exit and return the tool's exit code. Do not add --strict and do not change the timeout value (ticket, Assumptions).

The variants the test derives (path or rule_id changed, an entry duplicated, rule_id removed) are named in its header.

Mutants killed: round 1 exempt glob crossing '/', exempt by substring 'korrektur.html', only timeouts in scope (question 3 'nein'), Semgrep exit ignored, message printed, errors without path out of scope, list type printed raw; round 2 exemption applied to findings (A1), missing or empty --semgrep-exit taken as 0 (A2), glob as a search (W1), case-insensitive glob (W1), errors out of scope not printed (W2).
